implementation.geometry: the probe keeps the DIP rectangle and the DIP virtual-screen intersection, maps only the display sample through the scale, reports geometry.dip_rect, geometry.physical_rect and geometry.physical_visible, and clamps every bitmap index to the captured bitmap
implementation.evidence_flag: native_observe.py --probe-record writes the probe raw JSON (bounded by MAX_RECORD_BYTES) so scale/geometry/matched survive with the run
implementation.validation: --dpi-scale rejects non-numeric, non-finite and out-of-range values as ARGS_SCALE; the probe rejects non-finite or out-of-range values as CAP_RANGE

scale_1_0.note: the pre-fix behaviour; the earlier 125 % HOLD recorded 43/49 and no PNG

verifiable_125_record.note: the probe raw JSON is retained with the observer record via --probe-record, so scale, matched/samples and both rectangles are auditable from the saved run; the same PNG digest reproduces

negative_control.note: a mismatched scale on a 100 % display refuses, so the flag is not a free pass

interpretation: At 125 % the same window, thresholds and identity checks move from a 43/49 refusal to a stable 46/49 observation, and three independent observer runs produce the identical PNG digest. The failure was the probe comparing a DIP-sized capture against physical screen coordinates; the explicit scale maps the sample into one frame.
not_measured: pointer hit testing, popup/menu placement and focus/scroll anchor preservation under fractional scale
MP-TYP1 pixel/typography acceptance items (glyph coverage, clipping, baseline, contrast)
